# Bryn by Civic

> Bryn is the Signal-Based GTM agent for Growth teams. Bryn watches anonymous and known product, web, and intent signals, names the pattern, and runs the Play you approved, with the audit log attached.

Bryn identifies the companies on your website, scores them against your ICP, and acts on them through Plays: Slack alerts, CRM updates, outreach, and on-page personalization. Setup is a pixel on your site and a few dashboard steps at https://bryn.civic.com.

## Start here

- [Bryn](https://docs.civic.com/bryn): Bryn is the Signal-Based GTM agent for Growth teams
- [Get started with Bryn](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/getting-started): Your first identified visitor in Slack in about 30 minutes
- [How Bryn works](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/how-bryn-works): From anonymous visit to action: the whole loop

## Set up Bryn

- [Install the pixel](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/pixel): Get the Bryn pixel live on every page of your site
- [Map your signals](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/signal-mapping): Turn raw events into the named signals Bryn acts on
- [Define your ICP and scoring](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/icp-and-scoring): What the score means and when to tune it
- [Connect Slack and other outputs](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/outputs): Send what Bryn finds to where your team works
- [Turn on Plays](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/plays): Enable automated workflows that act on qualified accounts

## Connectors

- [Connectors](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/connectors): The third-party tools Bryn reads from, learns from, and delivers to
- [Amazon SES](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/connectors/amazon-ses): Connect your own Amazon SES account as an email output for Bryn
- [Apify](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/connectors/apify): Run Apify actors to enrich accounts, and turn your own scheduled actor runs into events in Bryn
- [Apollo](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/connectors/apollo): Look accounts and people up in Apollo and enrol the people your Plays pick into Apollo sequences
- [Calendly](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/connectors/calendly): Turn Calendly bookings and cancellations into signals on the accounts and people Bryn tracks
- [Clay](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/connectors/clay): Look up company size, industry, and location in Clay to fill in the accounts Bryn sees

## Use Bryn

- [Website Personalization Recipes](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/frontend-recipes): Copy-paste snippets to personalize your site with the Bryn pixel
- [MCP Server](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/mcp): Connect an MCP client to the Bryn MCP server

## Developers

- [API overview and authentication](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/api-overview): Base URLs, auth, and tenant selection for the Control Plane API
- [Server-side events & signing](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/signing): Send events from your backend, signed so Bryn knows they came from you
- [API reference](https://docs.civic.com/bryn/api/bryn-control-plane-api): Endpoint reference for the Bryn Control Plane API
